effort: Review clean straight-line projection and purposeful push/pull force under controlled, documented conditions.

explosive.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused
explosive.job: Primary final reference for clean straight-ahead force expression under the original task conditions.
explosive.cue: Match the Class 1 ball/type, parallel stance, 1 s still chest hold, target and rest when actual records exist. Release symmetrically without dip, step or twist. No bonus attempts.
explosive.replacement: a self-anchored bilateral band speed chest press if release containment fails; record that the original throw reference cannot be compared
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Explicit comparison exception: exact Class 1 drill and 3 × 3 dose. A novel final throw cannot provide the same reference. Without actual Class 1 data this establishes current quality only; it does not prove improvement.
explosive.key: Medicine Ball Chest Pass — stationary, paused

explosive.name: Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue
explosive.job: Retain organized independent force onset without additional ball or hand-impact exposure.
explosive.cue: Self-anchored band, other hand secures tail at torso; wait 2–4 s for a simple cue, press rapidly and return 2 s without trunk rotation.
explosive.replacement: a self-initiated single-arm band speed press if cue timing reduces control
explosive.identity: band-chest-press parent; same cued execution as Class 11
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 11 repeat at its small dose. A new reactive-direction task was rejected because the final reference session should not add unrelated decision demands; the cue remains within the pressing task.
explosive.key: Single-Arm Band Chest Press — still start on a spoken cue

explosive.name: One-Arm Row — supported mid-range pause into fast finish
explosive.job: Express each arm's final draw without borrowing force from the trunk.
explosive.cue: Light dumbbell, hand/knee supported; hold with elbow partly bent for 2 s, draw toward hip quickly, then lower fully for 2 s before resetting. No shoulder roll.
explosive.replacement: a full-range light supported speed row if the partial start feels strained
explosive.identity: one-arm-dumbbell-row parent; unilateral partial-start rapid delivery proposed
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Related to the Class 7 full-range unilateral speed row and Class 10 bilateral finish task. It combines independent arm control with a held finish-range start, without claiming a new rowing family.
explosive.key: One-Arm Row — supported mid-range pause into fast finish

explosive.name: Floor Press — alternating light speed presses, opposite arm parked
explosive.job: Coordinate alternating forward arm force while retaining control of the other load.
explosive.cue: Both dumbbells start with upper arms gently on floor. Press one arm quickly while the other remains parked at the floor boundary, lower 2 s, then switch; four total presses, two per arm. No simultaneous lift, torso roll or weight release.
explosive.replacement: two simultaneous bilateral light floor-press cycles if alternating load handling is unsuitable; record changed cycle counting
explosive.identity: Floor Press family; alternating rapid delivery proposed
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Related to earlier single-arm and bilateral speed presses. Alternating loaded-arm coordination is explicit; this is not considered wholly new because dumbbells or tempo changed. Only four speed reps precede primary work.
explosive.key: Floor Press — alternating light speed presses, opposite arm parked

explosive.name: Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return
explosive.job: Keep a small shoulder-driven backward force task without another elbow-flexion set.
explosive.cue: Very light loads, steady hinge, softly fixed elbows; quick comfortable opening, lower 2 s, no trunk or shrug assistance.
explosive.replacement: an unloaded same-path rapid opening if even light load alters control
explosive.identity: Proposed exact execution; no verified canonical identifier
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 10 repeat reduced to three reps. A novel rope or hanging task would add setup/grip load without improving the shoulder-only support job before the final strength reference.
explosive.key: Dumbbell Reverse Fly — quick lift, controlled return

explosive.name: Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — forward-facing, no rotation
explosive.job: Review current independent-arm projection with a simple fixed-base task.
explosive.cue: Manageable ball at shoulder; fixed split stance, opposite foot forward, no deliberate rotation or step. Release forward and let the ball stop.
explosive.replacement: a secured single-arm band speed press when ball fit or containment is unsuitable; log the release gap
explosive.uniqueness_reason: Class 1/6 repeat checks current side control at the original two-per-arm dose. A new step or overhead release was rejected to avoid more complexity; because preceding work differs, do not treat this as a controlled before/after performance test.
explosive.key: Medicine Ball Shot Put Throw — forward-facing, no rotation

resilience.name: Scapular Push-Up — quadruped, dynamic
resilience.job: Lightly load controlled shoulder-blade travel for pushing support and force transfer.
resilience.cue: Hands and knees down; keep elbows straight. Settle chest 2 s, push away 2 s, hold 2 s without trunk sag.
resilience.replacement: a smaller controlled scapular range with more weight supported at knees

resilience.name: Bilateral Band External Rotation — elbows at sides
resilience.job: Light shoulder-rotator strengthening to control upper-arm position during the day's press and pull.
resilience.cue: Unanchored band between hands, elbows at ribs; rotate outward 2 s, hold 1 s, return 2 s without shrugging.
resilience.replacement: a lower-tension band and shorter comfortable range
resilience.key: Bilateral Band External Rotation — elbows at sides

primary.name: Floor Press — two dumbbells, neutral grip
primary.job: Main horizontal pressing force with a reproducible floor-limited range.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, touch upper arms gently, pause 1 s, then press decisively; feet stay down. Coach supervises pickup/set-down.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor press through controlled comfortable range

primary.name: One-Arm Row — dumbbell, hand and knee on bench
primary.job: Load the arm-driven backward draw while support prevents torso rotation.
primary.cue: Draw elbow toward hip, hold 1 s, lower 2 s; stop before the shoulder rolls forward or the trunk turns.
primary.replacement: a thigh-supported dumbbell row with the same arm path if a bench does not fit

primary.name: Push-Up — controlled full repetition
primary.job: Load the press with free shoulder-blade movement and a steady trunk.
primary.cue: Lower 2 s, push decisively, finish tall through shoulders for 1 s; no hand flight. Adjust leverage or band resistance to reach 2–3 RIR.
primary.replacement: a hands-elevated push-up on an inspected immovable support

primary.name: Dumbbell Rear-Delt Row — bilateral, hinged
primary.job: Strengthen the wider-elbow backward draw that controls the arm-open position.
primary.cue: Hold a still hinge; elbows about 60 degrees from torso, pull to upper ribs, hold 1 s, lower 2 s.
primary.replacement: a chest-supported version only on an inspected bench with adequate arm clearance

primary.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher — floor-supported
primary.job: Load elbow extension for the finish of a forceful press.
primary.cue: Neutral grips, upper arms near vertical; lower 2 s beside the ears, extend under control without shoulder swing.
primary.replacement: a lighter floor-supported elbow extension through comfortable range

primary.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl — simultaneous arms
primary.job: Load elbow flexors for finishing the backward draw without another shoulder-extension set.
primary.cue: Upper arms stay at ribs; lift 1 s, hold 1 s, lower 2 s, without hip swing or wrist collapse.
primary.replacement: a lighter neutral-grip curl without body movement

progression: Class 11 reduced two pressing supports to six reps. Here the original Class 1 strength prescription is restored: Floor Press 2 × 6, Row 2 × 6 per arm and one set of eight for each other lift, eight rounds and 68 task reps. Use current technically suitable loads at 2–3 RIR; repeat a prior load only if it remains appropriate. Compare actual load/quality records descriptively because preceding explosive exposure and readiness may differ. The exact E1 drill/dose is repeated for a possible matched reference; no athlete completion or improvement has been supplied. The next cycle should target a limitation shown by actual response, not an invented successful outcome.
audit_findings: Four exact drill repeats are documented as closing-reference/low-complexity exceptions and two related task variants are labeled honestly. Thirteen throws, zero catches/steps/hand landings; no extra test slot. Original primary prescriptions are restored without maximal testing or automatic loading. The full-sequence audit records reconciliation of classes, uniqueness, workload, progression, timing and unresolved delivery assumptions.
next_job: All 12 class prescriptions are saved. See the full-sequence audit and current state for the completed document review. Before delivery or revision, review actual preparation, site, booking, athlete execution and recovery; no Class 13 is automatically due.
